tagline: The Asian side's scenic sports peninsula — the famous football club's ground, a beautiful park, yacht harbour, and stunning Marmara views.

items.name: Fenerbahçe Parkı Çay Bahçesi
items.description: Tea gardens inside the beautiful Fenerbahçe Park with sea views on all sides. One of the Asian side's most pleasant spots for a relaxed morning.

items.name: Kalamış Marina Restoranları
items.description: A cluster of good restaurants and cafés around the Kalamış yacht marina. Waterfront dining with views of boats and the Marmara.

items.name: Fenerbahçe Parkı
items.description: A beautiful forested peninsula park stretching into the Sea of Marmara. Cycling, jogging, and sea views in every direction. One of Istanbul's best urban parks.
items.tip: Rent a bicycle at the park entrance and cycle the full perimeter — takes about 45 minutes and the views are excellent.

items.name: Fenerbahçe Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadyumu
items.description: The iconic home ground of Fenerbahçe SK — one of Turkey's greatest football clubs. Stadium tours available on non-match days.
items.tip: Match day atmosphere is electric. Buy tickets online well in advance — popular games sell out fast.

tips: Fenerbahçe is easily reached from Kadıköy by bus or dolmuş (about 15-20 minutes).
The park and marina area are far more pleasant than the commercial Kadıköy centre — a good escape.
On match days, the entire Kadıköy district buzzes with Fenerbahçe supporters. Worth experiencing even as a neutral.
Combine Fenerbahçe Park with a walk to Caddebostan along the Marmara coast.
